title: Chapter 388: The Past Glory
content:
Chapter 388: The Past Glory

Now, the opportunity is right in front of you!

And Yue Shi Shen also knew how hard-earned this opportunity was.

That day, the entire land of gods was filled with the howling of that man. He rushed towards the gods with the expectations of the Moon clan and countless small tribes oppressed by the gods.

His aura was as if it was endless, and he was so excited that he saw countless strong men behind him.

They even had fantasized about the scene of the victory of the Moon Killing God in advance, and imagined the glorious scene of the days without oppression, and the blooming of flowers of all races.

Until God took action.

"Ant."

One of the giant pillars that spread out into the sky emitted a dazzling and eye-catching light.

A terrifying pressure followed, and a huge figure mixed with endless hostility slowly emerged from the land of the gods.

Under the shocked gaze of countless powerful people, the huge figure raised his arms high, and with just one blow, he defeated the incredible Yue Slayer God.

Everyone's eyes gradually changed from excitement to horror, then to despair, and finally at a loss.

"how so."

"Is this God's strength?"

"So that's what the slightest sways the tree."

That battle was not that huge, but it was like a wave, eroding the hearts of countless creatures in the world.

God, invincible.

The shackles of sentient beings have a little aggravated again.

At this point, Lu Daosheng shook his head gently, and in the end, Yue Shi Shen naturally did not execute him by the god.

But since then, he has never been the same person he was again.

He began to please the Land of Gods, flatter him, bent down to his enemy he once hated the most, lowered his head and shook his tail.

In a sense, Yue Shi God is indeed dead.

Since then, there has been no more god-killer.

As the culprit, the Moon Clan has also imposed sanctions.

The entire Moon Clan is almost dead, with only some of its bloodline remaining.

Lu Daosheng learned from Yue Shi Shen’s memory that these are his contributions.

But no one knows all this, including the surviving Yue tribe members.

"Do you regret it?"

After a long silence, Lu Daosheng suddenly asked softly.

Hearing this question, Yue Shi Shen showed a miserable smile. Of course, he knew what Lu Daosheng was referring to.

I regret it, it's simply regretting it.

If it weren't for him, even if the Moon Clan was oppressed, it wouldn't have died to the point where it was almost destroyed.

All of this is because of his arrogance and conceit.

But, if he could do it again, he would still do this!

Because, he is the moon killer!

Yue Shi Shen didn't say anything, but Lu Daosheng knew the answer from his eyes.

This man has never given up.

The so-called sleeping on firewood and tasting gall is nothing more than that.

"Do you want to take revenge?"

Lu Daosheng asked again.

"think."

Yue Shi Shen stood up slowly and looked directly into Lu Daosheng's eyes. His eyes were so firm, but it seemed to have a hint of prayer.

"I can't do it on my own."

This is a fact. Although Yue Shi God is amazing and talented, the world is very big and big. Yue Shi God's talent is just so amazing in the world where he is.

He was like the number one in the village, and when he came to the town, his talent was not so dazzling.

And when he arrived in the county and the province, he seemed very ordinary.

The probability of relying solely on the Moon Killing God is not without the real God killing, but it is definitely very low, so low that the Moon Killing God almost gave up.

If it weren't for the strong revenge mentality that kept supporting him, he might have really given up.

But when Lu Daosheng heard this, he shook his head slightly, which made Yue Shi Shen frown.

Isn't it?

However, Lu Daosheng said in his heart that there is no three words "Impossible" in this world.

As long as he thinks, he can quickly make the strength of the Yueshen God in front of him soar, surpassing the land of the gods, which is easy.

But, of course, he wouldn't do that.

That doesn't fit his style.

What's more, why should he help him if he is not a relative or a good person?

To be honest, Lu Daosheng has not killed Yue Shi God now, and Yue Shi God is about to burn high incense.

After all, at the beginning, Yue Shi Shen was the first to attack Lu Dao.

If it weren't for the experience of Yue Shi God, Yue Shi God would have died and disappeared at this moment.

But at this time, Lu Daosheng became very interested in the man in front of him who had experienced ups and downs.

Without waiting for Yue Shi Shen to speak, Lu Daosheng grabbed Yue Shi Shen and took Yue Shi Shen to the space.

"what are you up to?"

Yue Shi God's face changed slightly, and he said in a little confused.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, "Go and see where you have been."

A place where you have been?

Yue Shi Shen was stunned for a moment, his face suddenly looked a little ugly, but at the same time, he felt a little expectant in his heart.

He has never been back since that time.

The place where he gave birth to and raised him.

He had no face to face it.

But Lu Daosheng naturally wouldn't care so much, he just wanted to go and have a look.

Moonlight Realm.

A long time ago, there was a brilliant race here - the Moon Clan.

That is the few race that dares to resist the land of the gods.

More importantly, the Moon Clan is also one of the few strong clans who can defeat the land of the gods.

Such a brilliant race should be admired and respected by countless creatures even if it fails, but the reality is exactly the opposite.

Not only was the moon tribe not recognized by sentient beings, but was also subjected to endless ridicule and slander.

It's all because of that man.

It was that man who brought the moon clan into glory, and it was that man who pushed the moon clan into endless abyss.

Success is the month of killing the god, defeat is the month of killing the god.

The ancestral land of the moon clan.

A small place with a lot of breath.

There are hundreds of tablets placed in several small temples that are somewhat sloppy.

Those are the ancestors of the Moon Clan.

At this moment, a childish young man quietly walked into the temple. He looked a little nervous. He came in and looked around. He felt relieved when he saw no one, so he tiptoed to the tablet. forward.

Looking at the dazzling array of tablets in front of him, the young man looked solemn.

He glanced at the corner, a tablet that was thrown there, walked up and picked it up gently, wiped the dust off with his sleeves, and then placed it in front of the tablets.

"Old ancestor, they all accuse you of God, saying that you are a lackey of God, but I don't think so. If we were not for you, how could we survive until now?"

"Old ancestor, you can't just be so decadent. Without you, who would have brought the moon clan to rise again? Of course, you can find a successor."

Speaking of this, the boy's face turned a little rosy unconsciously. He coughed lightly and continued to say to himself: "I think I am very good. There is no one more talented person in the entire Moon Clan now."

"Old ancestor, if you can hear me, come and pick me up."
